detailed_description: Review English text with browser-local static rules for common misspellings, repeated words, subject-verb agreement patterns, spacing, and punctuation. The page highlights matched text and lets you apply one or all available suggestions. It does not use AI or server processing, so review the corrected draft yourself for context and meaning.
usage_steps: Paste English text into the input field
Review the rule matches highlighted in the preview
Apply individual suggestions or all available fixes
Read the corrected English text before copying it
usage_examples: Catch a repeated word in an English email
Find common English misspellings such as teh or recieve
Review simple agreement and punctuation patterns in an English draft
